title: Create a default Algolia theme
body:
Now that we have the default theme skeleton, we need to build a default Algolia theme.
- [ ] No bootstrap dependencies
- [ ] No extra `cssClasses` required on the widgets
- [ ] Avoid showy colors to fit with most websites
- [ ] Ability to change the colors easily

comments.body: We currently have a `themes/default.css` (the skeleton) that only adds basic bold and margin. Are you talking about a new theme?
This has been postponed and replaced by a mandatory `instantsearch.css` file to require. We'll open a new issue once we'll work on themes.
